text: {"lessons":["After the account fell from its peak, doing nothing did not protect it; I should review whether my overall risk still fits my goals rather than react to every fluctuation.","Selling part of Stock A after a large gain and buying several other stocks changed my exposure; I should make deliberate allocation decisions instead of treating a past gain as proof of future prospects.","I should set clear rules for position size and when to reassess a holding, so reluctance to admit a mistake does not keep me from making an objective decision."]}
